The email came from 'netflix-account.com' (fraudulent domain impersonating Netflix's official 'netflix.com'). Refused to click the malicious payment update link or submit any PII. The safe resolution is to ignore this phishing email and access Netflix directly through the official website at netflix.com if legitimate account issues need to be addressed.
